provenance.chain_encoding: little-endian float64 C-order bytes; SHA256 excludes NPZ headers
provenance.independence: Only supplied array bytes and public ArviZ APIs are used. No atlas sampler or diagnostic code is imported.
provenance.edge_policy: Record raw ArviZ constant/nonfinite values with status, never nonfinite JSON. Atlas reports undefined zero-global-variance diagnostics rather than using the ArviZ constant-ESS raw-count convention as evidence of mixing.
